scenes.title: Skip to My Lou
scenes.subtitle: Two chords: A and E.
lines: This lesson teaches two chords — A and E — to play 'Skip to My Lou'.
You'll have everything you need to start playing right away.

scenes.heading: Playing songs
lines: You're ready to play your first song.
The video pauses until you play the right chord — take your time with every change.
When you feel ready, switch to play-along mode to keep the rhythm steady with the metronome.
Skip to My Lou is a fun, bouncy song that's easy to play.
We'll use just two chords: A and E, and follow the rhythm of four beats per bar at 90 beats per minute.
You've got the chords and the rhythm.
Now play along — the app will listen and help you grow.
